name: Microwave Vegetable Pulao
ingredients: ⅓ cup basmati rice, rinsed and soaked 15 minutes
1 cup mixed vegetables (carrot, peas, beans), diced
½ tsp cumin seeds, 1 bay leaf, 2 cloves
steps: In a large microwave-safe bowl, microwave the oil, cumin, bay leaf and cloves on high for 1 minute.
Add the ginger-garlic paste, vegetables and garam masala; microwave 2 minutes.
Add the drained rice, chickpeas, water and salt. Stir.
Cover with a vented lid and microwave on high for 5 minutes, then at 50% for 10 minutes.
Stand covered for 5 minutes, fluff and add coriander.
note: Soaked rice cooks evenly in the microwave; the chickpeas lift the protein.
